svg.title: Top cited domain concentration in two separate 2026 datasets
svg.desc: SearchIntel reported the top ten domains accounted for 21.9 percent of 6,119 citations in its June 2026 benchmark. A separate brand reputation study reported 80 percent of citations came from about 18 percent of domains. These are different datasets and not directly comparable.
svg.text: Citation concentration depends on the dataset
Two separate studies use different samples and concentration measures
Brand reputation study: share of citations from top ~18% domains
Sources: SearchIntel, AI Search Visibility Benchmarks 2026 Edition 1; Zatuchin, How Large Language Models Source Brand Reputation Across Languages and Markets, 2026.
Different studies, samples and metrics. Do not compare these values as if they came from one experiment.
